disagreements.topic: Q3 2026 earnings date and whether it falls in the 1-month window
disagreements.resolution: Most likely Wednesday 2026-11-04, after the 1-month horizon. The 1-month close is Friday 2026-10-30, because 2026-11-01 is a Sunday. Materion has not announced the date; it normally announces about two weeks ahead (the Q2 date was announced 2026-07-22). Over the last 4 years Materion has reported Q3 exactly 33 days after the fiscal quarter end, always on a Wednesday: 2022-09-30 -> 11-02, 2023-09-29 -> 11-01, 2024-09-27 -> 10-30, 2025-09-26 -> 10-29. Q2 2026 followed the same rule (07-03 -> 08-05). Fiscal 2026 quarters end Apr 3 and Jul 3, so Q3 ends Oct 2 and the rule points to Nov 4. MarketBeat's estimated date is also Nov 4. The Oct 29 date is a carry-over of last year's date.

FY2026 consensus is $7.02 (stockanalysis, 6 analysts) to $7.04 (MarketBeat), right at the $7.00 guide midpoint. FY2027 consensus is about $8.4-8.5: MarketBeat shows $8.48, which matches $8.39 and $8.44 from independent screens. The ~$7.9 figure is an NTM blend, not FY2027, and should not be used. Q3 2026: $1.89 (Benzinga, post-raise) holds. MarketBeat's $1.55 looks stale, from before the August raise. The guide implies H2 adjusted EPS of $3.63-4.03 (midpoint $3.83, ~$1.92 per quarter) after H1's $3.17. All the forecasts sit within about ±2% of the FY2027 consensus, so this disagreement barely moves value.

Company-defined net debt at 2026-07-03 was $420.7M: debt $440.7M (ST $17.5M + LT $423.2M) less $20.0M cash. Gross debt before deferred fees was $442.3M, which explains agent 5's figure. Adding finance leases gives ~$433M; either base is defensible but should be stated. Use 21.1M diluted shares (Q2 weighted diluted 21.075M; 20,833,725 outstanding at 7/3/2026). Agent 5's use of 20.83M lifts its EV-based value by ~1.2%. These choices move fair value by less than $1-2/share.
